backup.production_rule: Function replacement only: health_checks_core_v1(uuid, boolean), patched from its LIVE body (md5(prosrc) 7564fc5c867a11ecc73df9ace925a018, read 2026-10-07, equal to 20260923030000_inventory_check_controlled_items_only.sql). One block changes: cleaner_fees_settled. fail = fee_paid_at set and fee_txn_id missing or not a live (non-void) transaction; warn = fee NULL or > 0, fee_paid_at null, cleaned more than 14 days ago; explicit 0 = no fee. Revoke from public, anon, authenticated re-asserted; create or replace keeps the live ACL (service_role EXECUTE from Supabase default privileges; the definer wrapper run_health_checks_service_v1 calls the core as owner). No table, column, row or other function touched. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs).

forward_verification.name: core_body_is_the_reviewed_patch
forward_verification.query: select md5(prosrc) = 'c2f531c7cf1aa2baf4d4c2d263b22ad6' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.health_checks_core_v1(uuid,boolean)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: fee_check_warns_on_age_and_counts_unpriced
forward_verification.query: select prosrc like '%(x.fee_amount is null or x.fee_amount > 0)%' and prosrc like '%x.cleaned_at < now() - interval ''14 days''%' and prosrc not like '%coalesce(x.fee_amount, 0) > 0%' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.health_checks_core_v1(uuid,boolean)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: core_keeps_definer_search_path_and_no_client_grant
forward_verification.query: select p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""'] and p.provolatile = 'v' and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.health_checks_core_v1(uuid,boolean)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.health_checks_core_v1(uuid,boolean)', 'execute') from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.health_checks_core_v1(uuid,boolean)'::regprocedure

rollback.safe_until: always (function body only; admin_health_check_runs refreshes on the next run)
